scientific_integrity: A complete analytical proof is supplied for the stopped constant-drift / beta-multiplicative-jump process, supported by a standalone finite stochastic checker; no independent audit or field validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Soil salt mass only, not moisture-dependent salt concentration
Fixed positive deterministic input, homogeneous Poisson leaching, independent exponential-mark losses
No calibration to field soil or crop outcomes
Historical priority remains uncertain against broader exit and growth-collapse literature, including inaccessible full text of Boxma et al. (2005/2006)
title: Exact above-threshold salt-mass excursion law for Poisson leaching with exponential marks
